---
description: REST API design rules for route handlers
alwaysApply: true
---

# API design

- Every route validates input with zod before touching the database.
- Errors return `{ error: { code, message } }` with a stable code slug.
- No endpoint may return more than 100 items without a cursor.

---
description: React component conventions
globs: *.tsx,src/components/**
alwaysApply: false
---

# Component rules

- One component per file, named export matching the filename.
- Props interfaces are declared above the component, suffixed `Props`.

---
description: TypeScript conventions for all source files
globs:
  - "src/**/*.ts"
  - "src/**/*.tsx"
alwaysApply: false
---

# TypeScript rules

- `strict` mode is on; never add `// @ts-ignore` without a linked issue.
- Exported functions require explicit return types.
- Use discriminated unions over enums.

You are working on Storefront, a Next.js 14 e-commerce app.

- Use the app router; never add pages/ routes.
- Prefer server components; mark client components explicitly.
- All prices are integer cents. Never use floats for money.
- Run `pnpm lint` before proposing a diff.
